 b=(authorManifest.parent/p).read_bytes();own=(actualManifest.parent/p).read_bytes();live=(root/p).read_bytes();aux=(runtime/p).read_bytes();old=(coder/p).read_bytes()
 assert sha(b)==s and b==own==live==aux,p
 oldSame=b==old
 if not oldSame:
  assert p=='apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json';a=json.loads(b);o=json.loads(old);assert a['context'].pop('commit')==m['commit'];o['context'].pop('commit');assert a==o
 files.append({'file':p,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':s,'ownManagedLiveMatch':True,'ownCloneLiveMatch':True,'ownImmutableMatch':True,'authorPhysicalImmutableMatch':True,'original594RuntimeSameBytes':oldSame,'onlyCommitMetadataDiff':not oldSame})
assert len(files)==206 and sum(x['original594RuntimeSameBytes'] for x in files)==205
(r/'evidence/engineering-manifest.json').write_bytes(mb)
(r/'evidence/engineering-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':m['commit'],'authorDocsHEAD':'be6f40e9f551cdc1484293d46ab5884db1c0cc41','buildId':m['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(mb),'manifestBytes':len(mb),'profileSHA256':profileSHA,'independentIdentitySHA256':identitysha,'payloads':len(files),'freshCloneBuildActual':True,'authorPhysicalManifest':str(authorManifest),'ownPhysicalManifest':str(actualManifest),'files':files,'previousRuntimeReadOnly':True,'previousManifestNotChanged':True},indent=2)+'\n')
